info.name: Coordle Backend API
info.description: Complete API collection for Coordle backend including user management, authentication, verification, and profile options

item.name: Send Login Verification Code (For Existing Users)
item.description: Use this endpoint for existing users who want to login with phone verification. This endpoint requires the user to already exist in the database.

item.name: Check User by Phone Number
item.description: Check if a user exists by phone number. This helps determine whether to use registration or login flow.

item.name: Send Verification Code (For New User Registration)
item.description: Use this endpoint for new user registration. This endpoint will block if the phone number is already verified for another user.
